title: Write landing intent and landing records in land --pr (job 3 part 1)
summary: Retry the records-history job 3 part 1: land_pr writes a landing intent to athena/records and pushes it before merging, then a landing record (second parent = PR head) after, with remote-tip build, leased push, and bounded retry. This time include a test through Athena::land_pr (fake Runner, bare remote) so the production wiring used by drain.rs is proven, and document the stale-marker warning and failure-path table.

defaults_applied.how: All code and tests in Rust.
Tests exercise land_pr behavior through production entry points.
Design doc updated with failure-path table.
Push recovery builds on remote tip rather than patching divergence.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: land_pr's records history for maintainers/verifier reviewing the athena/records branch; the user's earlier decisions (remote is source of truth, lease push, bounded retry, warn when unconfirmed, drain.rs covered, error naming sha) stand.
The prior failure was a planning gap: Athena::land_pr takes a &dyn Runner, so it can be tested with a fake runner; the test must go through it, not only the free gh::land_pr.
An unconfirmed-merge report with warnings keeps the existing exit code; main.rs stays unchanged unless needed.
display.rs changes only if PrReport literals need the new warning field; listed with low probability.

acceptance_criteria.text: Fake-host test of a successful land_pr reads the records branch and finds a landing-intent record then a landing record, in that order. Intent: PR number, head sha, head tree, expected base, job ids. Landing: PR number, head sha, host commit, merge method, commits with tree/job/verification, intent id. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
A test shows the records commit carrying the landing record has the PR head sha as its second parent. Run: cargo test.
A test with a fake host that refuses the merge shows the records branch and remote hold the intent and no landing record, and land_pr returns its existing error. Run: cargo test.
A call-order test with a bare remote shows the intent is pushed to the remote before PrHost::merge is called and the landing record after. Run: cargo test.

Rejected-push test: remote records branch moves between build and push; the commit is rebuilt on the fetched remote tip and retried (bounded), succeeds, local and remote tips match. Commit built on remote tip, pushed with a lease, local ref moves only after push succeeds. Run: cargo test.

Leftover-local-intent test: a local records ref ahead of or diverged from the remote is reset to the remote before writing; the next land_pr succeeds with no divergence error, and the merge never happens without its intent on the remote. Run: cargo test.

Merged-but-unconfirmed test: no landing record is written and the PrReport warning names the intent, the merge-requested marker path and how to clear it; a rerun creates no duplicate records. Run: cargo test.

A test calls Athena::land_pr (the path drain.rs PrLander uses) with a fake Runner answering gh calls and origin pointing at a bare repo, and asserts intent and landing on the remote records branch; it fails if Athena::land_pr passes no records writer. Run: cargo test.
A commit between the remote base and the PR head with no landing trailer or verification gives an error naming its sha and saying it lies between the remote base and the PR head. Run: cargo test.
Existing land and land_pr tests (trailers, records under records/, resync_onto_merge rebuild) pass unchanged; cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo fmt --check are clean.

Records use the athena-data history.rs types (LandingIntent, Landing, LandingCommit, MergeMethod), are validated before writing, and are written through the athena-git RecordsWriter, not a new writer.

docs/design/records-history.md states how sync_from changed (or the distinct recover path) and has a failure-path table (starting state, function, cited behavior) including the stale merge-requested marker row and the exit code for a report with warnings; new functions carry doc comments citing the design section; CHANGELOG.md has an entry.

out_of_scope: Job 3 part 2 (reconcile) repair of unconfirmed merges
Changing trailers, records under records/, or resync_onto_merge behavior
departures: Larger than reference: multi-crate change with many test scenarios and a prior failed attempt.
